title.en: Separate optical paths at optical modules

text.zh: 混合连接项目在光模块侧分别确认光接口、通道和设备端跳线，独立电源或其他信号按各自连接表布置。共同护套与分支结构不表示光通道和电路共用接点，也不等于自带光电转换。
text.en: In a mixed-connection project, define optical interfaces, channels and equipment-side jumpers at the optical module separately. Route independent power or other signals from their own maps. Shared jackets and breakouts do not establish shared contacts or built-in optical-electrical conversion.

title.en: Optical-link projects in video equipment rooms

text.zh: 机架设备光口与配线侧的连接，需按实际光模块资料确认端口、收发方向和跳线长度。MPO等集中接口通过指定配线结构与设备端跳线对应，不默认直接对插LC光口。
text.en: Define ports, transmit/receive direction and jumper lengths between rack optical modules and distribution equipment from the actual module documents. text.en: Where commercial heating equipment uses thermocouple inputs, keep probe, extension and controller type and polarity aligned. directions.copyAdjustmentReason: The published photograph shows a general electronic bench and oscilloscope, not an identified temperature recorder or RTD/thermocouple acquisition input. A real commercial-heating application gives clearer visual support.

title.zh: 商用加热设备温控连接
title.en: Temperature-control connections for commercial heating equipment

text.zh: 商用加热设备采用热电偶输入时，探头、延长段与温控仪表需保持分度和极性对应。腔体内外的材料转换、参考接点和冷端补偿按设备方案确认，避免把仪表环境温度当作测点温度。
text.en: Where commercial heating equipment uses thermocouple inputs, keep probe, extension and controller type and polarity aligned. Define material transitions, the reference junction and cold-junction compensation across the chamber boundary from the equipment design, distinguishing instrument ambient temperature from the sensing point.

directions.copyAdjustmentReason: The published photograph shows a general electronic bench and oscilloscope, not an identified temperature recorder or RTD/thermocouple acquisition input. A real commercial-heating application gives clearer visual support.

text.zh: 家电采用热电偶测温的项目，需分别确认传感器、温控模块及可拆接口。引线经过加热区、机壳和维修位置时，各段材料、固定和接点要求按设备资料安排。
text.en: For appliance projects using thermocouples, define the sensor, temperature-control module and removable interfaces separately. Plan materials, retention and junction requirements for leads passing through heated areas, the enclosure and service positions from equipment documents.

directions.copyAdjustmentReason: Replaces general copper-wire or material-category defaults with the actual RTD/thermocouple measurement topic.

title.zh: 发动机外围温度监测项目

text.zh: 发动机外围的热电偶测温项目，需把实际测点、探头结构和引线经过的温区分开定义。按具体分度、接口与固定路径配置连接，并将参考接点和仪表区的热环境纳入验证。
text.en: For thermocouple projects around an engine, define the sensing point, probe construction and temperature zones along the lead separately. Configure the connection for the specified type, interfaces and support route, and include reference-junction and instrument-area thermal conditions in validation.

directions.copyAdjustmentReason: The published photograph is a laboratory sample analyzer with sample tubes and mechanics; no temperature-feedback module is visible. Replace with a clear engine thermal-environment application and matching project-scoped copy.
